metadata.purpose: Pair values by arrival index using one FIFO per input; retain completed input queues until exhausted.

conditions: Input zero is the upstream source; remaining inputs are supplied as rest Observable arguments.
Output tuple k contains value k from each input; every admitted value contributes to at most one tuple.
The result completes when a completed input has no remaining queued value, including immediately after the last tuple.
With zero auxiliaries, each upstream value becomes a singleton tuple; no identity shortcut is assumed.

scope.parameters: One to sixteen total Observable inputs including source, tuple output, FIFO analysis bound 1..32 per input. The bound limits modeled histories; RxJS itself does not enforce it.
scope.callbacks: No user projector in the canonical profile. Payloads remain opaque and retain identity inside fresh output tuples.
scope.time: Source and auxiliary notifications supply time; the operator introduces no clock or scheduler. Equal-time arrivals retain explicit event order.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Synchronous acquisition-time notifications, arbitrary ObservableInput conversions and unbounded FIFO histories.
Optional legacy zip projector and array-argument overload behavior; these are separately characterized natively.
Unsafe count overflow and more than sixteen inputs.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: At first connection, source input zero then auxiliary inputs connect in argument order. Acquisition is non-notifying in this canonical profile.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

resources.owner: result execution; source index zero then auxiliary indexes

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: Opaque value from an indexed live input; input zero is upstream source.
Indexed input completes; its queued values may remain usable.
Indexed input fails with an opaque error.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Active.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.
Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

actions: acquire source input zero, then each auxiliary in argument order
rules.nextState: Every FIFO is empty, every input is live, and received/emitted counts are zero.
rules.explanation: Pipeable zip and zipWith acquire the upstream source first. No producer runs during model construction.

rules.guard: addressed input live; within FIFO/count scope; another FIFO remains empty
actions: append the opaque value to its input FIFO; emit nothing
rules.nextState: Only that FIFO and its received count change.
rules.explanation: Fast arrivals are retained in order. There is no latest-value replacement, source throttling or implicit backpressure.

rules.guard: addressed input live; every FIFO becomes nonempty; no completed FIFO is exhausted
actions: remove one oldest value from every FIFO
emit one fresh tuple in input order
rules.nextState: Received count advances for arriving input; emitted count advances once; unmatched values remain queued.
rules.explanation: Any input can trigger a tuple. Exactly one tuple is emitted per admitted arrival because a stable state has an empty FIFO.

rules.guard: addressed input live; tuple ready; removing it exhausts a previously completed FIFO
actions: emit one final tuple in input order
release remaining live inputs in subscription order
rules.nextState: Closed and all queued values released.
rules.explanation: A completed input can contribute its queued values, but no tuple is possible after its final queued value is consumed.

rules.guard: addressed input live and its FIFO is nonempty
actions: release this completed input connection only
rules.nextState: Input becomes non-live; its FIFO remains available for later tuples.
rules.explanation: Completion stops future arrivals, not already buffered contributions. Other inputs may still drain the retained values.

rules.guard: addressed input live and its FIFO is empty
actions: release all remaining live inputs in subscription order
rules.nextState: Closed; unmatched values in other FIFOs are discarded.
rules.explanation: Once one completed input has no remaining value, no future complete tuple can be formed.

actions: error downstream with the same opaque payload
release every remaining live input in subscription order
rules.nextState: Closed; queued values are discarded without a final tuple.
rules.explanation: Any input error terminates the combined result immediately.

actions: release remaining live input connections without a notification
rules.explanation: Closing the result connection is silent cancellation, not successful completion.
